---
title: "UKHSA Data Analysis"
author: "Joshua Ho"
format: html
---

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(gt)
```

Loading and viewing CSV of COVID-19 case rates per 100000 in population in the rolling 7-day period ending on date shown, from UKHSA website:

```{r}
COVID_19_case_rates <- read_csv("data/ukhsa-chart-download-COVID19-case-rates.csv")

gt(head(COVID_19_case_rates, n = 3))
# head() just visualises the first n lines of a table, default being 10
```

Plotting a table based on the UKHSA data:

```{r}
# ggplot() initiates a blank canvas and specifies data frame ie CSV to be used
# aes() allows for the axes to be set
# + afterwards allows for more layers to be added to the plot
# geom_line() plots the line

ggplot(COVID_19_case_rates, aes(
  x = date,
  y = metric_value
)) +
  geom_line(colour = "purple") +
  xlab("Date") +
  ylab("Case rates per 100000 (7-day rolling average)") +
  ggtitle("COVID-19 case rates")
```
